subject: [hw] DONE P03 rev 2 (R2 F27-F29 fixed; 550/550)
body:
Rev 2 of DONE P03. R2 accepted rev 1 (526/526) with three low findings; all three are fixed and the suite is now 550/550. No interface change.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/client/test/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST P03 PASS 550/550
(179/179 in ASan+UBSan -O1, 179/179 -O2, 179/179 TSan -O1; 12/12 the real n2vcd_cli end to end; 1/1 arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile gate with -Werror; ~10 s; /tmp/n2hw-P03 only.)

Fixes (commit 9568ae6, docs b276ef5):
- F27: after OPEN_OK, a calloc(session) failure now sends CLOSE like the two buffer-allocation failures (one shared close_opened_session()).
- F28: xact() checks the reply session centrally for every typed reply; OPEN_OK (new id) is the documented exception and ERROR replies are exempt because OPEN E_BUSY carries the existing session id. New fake-server case: typed reply for session 43 to a session-42 request -> E_SESSION, client broken, clean close.
- F29: n2vcd_transport_relay() probes RWVC_INFO at open and returns -EPROTO for an ABI mismatch (tested, fd closed); fails clearly instead of at HELLO.

Re-verified integration after these changes: a copy of hw-ips daemon/test/run_tests.sh with OUT redirected to my /tmp gives N2TEST IP PASS 722/722 (237/237 x3 + 11/11 real n2vhost) and the CLI log frame 0 bytes=1577 key=1, frame 1 bytes=10, done frames=2. So the client still drives the real daemon on SOCK_SEQPACKET with --dma-dir <socket>.buf.

Commits: 1908a5a, 19c7b5e, a5415cd, 82dff29, 972757e, 9568ae6, b276ef5. Files: client/** + dsh-state/workers/P03/STATUS.md only.
Not done (unchanged, full list in client/STATUS.md): no phone run; n2vc_hw.regs poll timeout is a documented 1 s default; n2vcd_server.c is an alternative to, not an addition to, daemon/n2vcd_srv.c; CLI H.264 only; no decoder API; enc_frame cap >= session out_bytes; second OPEN after E_BUSY not auto-retried. F27 is fixed by inspection only (no product allocation hook); say the word if you want a test-only allocator hook.
Staying available.
